Publish.LongDescription:
## 🅿️ Parking Control (PC)
Want clean curbs without changing your road design?
* Easy to use; prevents cars and motorcycles from choosing public street parking. * No need to add grass or wide sidewalks as workarounds. * Ban parking on single roads, 1-way alleys, with the **No Parking** road button!
**Mod of the Month**: [video here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keGjw8IzOOA)
## Choose where
Dropdown list in Options menu.
* **by District** recommended and the most versatile. Ban parking in any district while still using the manual **(P)** button on single roads or multi-selected roads.
* **Whole City** prevent street parking city-wide. Make sure the city has enough parking storage off street.
* **Manual Only** uses the **No Parking** button only. The district parking policy is hidden and any previously enabled district bans from this mod are turned off.
### Manual single roads
Use the **No Parking** button next to the Crosswalks button.
* **Left-click** a road to add No Parking. * **Right-click** to remove it.
Parking lots and building parking stay working normally.
Optional Status rows show parking usage with more detail than the game's info view.
## Good to know
* Make sure your city has enough off-street parking. When parking is unavailable, the game may use outside-connection storage or staging as it does in vanilla. * Some vanilla roads already don't allow parking, such as 3-lane small roads, highways, and 2-way alleys. * New or rebuilt roads may briefly accept a few cars while CS2 updates their parking lanes. * Safe to remove anytime and designed to not impact performance. * Optional 4-lane and 6-lane road parking bans work in addition to the main dropdown choice.
## Support and Feedback * Easiest way to support: click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. * Feedback and PRs are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links on the right.
**Planned:** centralized parking-fee controls.
## Credits and Thanks
* River-mochi - mod author * yenyang - technical consultant * Dataknase, Maintyper, DragonFire - testing * StarQ - no parking icon
## Languages English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Polski, Português Brasileiro, ไทย Thai, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Українська
## How does it work
* The mod uses the game's own ParkingDisabled flag on eligible roads. * It does not narrow the road, widen the sidewalk, or add a driving lane. The road looks the same. * Existing parked cars gradually relocate after parking is banned. * Optional: works with [Mochi's Hover Colors](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/146044/Windows). The manual road tool follows MHC's Bulldozer + Roads colors, just like normal road tools. * Manual No Parking is per road segment. If a crossing road or track splits it, re-apply No Parking to the new segments. District and whole-city bans are unaffected since they update all new segments.
